title: The all-errors fixture does not cover collect after teardown
description:
From the Phase 3 review (h0f, attempt 14), finding 6.

Tick 35h added a read of the archived report to herdr's readReport. The reviewer mutated that branch to call e.client.AgentGet and every Herdr|Durable|Report|Teardown|Archive test in exec/herdr stayed green: the zero-substrate-calls doctrine — collect makes no herdr calls, proven by an all-errors fixture — is untested on the post-teardown path 35h introduced.

Extend the all-errors fixture to collect AFTER the worktree is removed, so the doctrine covers the path that reads the archive.
acceptance_criteria: A mutation adding a substrate call to herdr's post-teardown report read fails the all-errors fixture
